parts.name: skirt
parts.keep: the skirt of overlapping blackened leather lamellar plates laced with cord, from the wide belt with its iron buckle down to the lowest row of plates, the belt at the top, as a garment on its own: no body, no legs, no arms, no hands, the garment hollow inside where the body was, seen straight from the front
